findings.description: When the final attempt fails, the loop breaks and the function falls off the end, returning None instead of a Charge or raising. In settle_invoice, `except GatewayError` is never triggered for exhausted retries, so execution continues to `charge.id` and raises AttributeError on None. That aborts the whole settle_open_invoices run, and the invoice is never marked PAYMENT_FAILED.
findings.suggestion: Keep the last exception and re-raise it after the loop (e.g. `raise` in place of `break`, or `raise last_exc`).
